thesis: Hold at the 10:30 ET tick. Sizing book is ~$250 VTI (~25% of ~$1000 equity) and ~$750 cash (~75%), above the 15% cash floor and under the 35% single-name cap with one position. Pre-cutoff news does not justify rotation: junk-bond stress (worst month since 2022) is macro credit context only; most SEC items are routine 8-Ks; Carnival filed Item 2.02 results but that is not a clear balanced-book catalyst at this scale. Context: VIX ~15.9 (slightly lower), 10Y ~5.255% (up slightly), weaker oil/USO; Morgan Stanley commentary favoring large-cap quality fits keeping broad VTI ballast rather than adding single names (Novo licensing, TSMC U.S. site) without consensus-level clarity. Balanced mandate: diversify on distinct catalysts—none here—so empty orders.
